biography: Roman De Angelis, a name now synonymous with aggressive overtaking and relentless determination, hails from the icy landscapes of Canada. His motorsport journey began not in a high-tech simulator, but on frozen lakes, mastering the art of car control on treacherous surfaces. This unorthodox training forged a driver with exceptional car control, a skill that sets him apart on the asphalt. A defining moment came early in his career during a regional karting championship. Despite starting last due to a mechanical issue, Roman carved his way through the field with a series of daring maneuvers, ultimately securing a podium finish. This raw talent and unwavering spirit caught the attention of Ethanol Silver, who quickly signed him. Now at the peak of his abilities, and driving for Aston Martin, Roman is a force to be reckoned with, a driver who leaves everything on the track, every single race.
drivingStyle: De Angelis is an unapologetically aggressive driver. He's known for late-braking overtakes that often leave rivals shaking their heads. He attacks corners with a ferocity that borders on reckless, pushing the limits of grip to gain every possible advantage. Tire management isn't always his strength; he prefers to extract maximum performance early in a stint, often sacrificing longevity for immediate gains. Under pressure, Roman thrives; the more intense the situation, the more calculated and decisive his driving becomes.

famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser. I'm here to win, no matter what it takes."
careerHighlight: Winning the 24 Hours of Spa after a nail-biting final stint, holding off a charging Isabelle Rossi by a mere tenth of a second.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of the Bathurst 12 Hour due to a mechanical failure, costing his team a certain victory.
